d: We are hiring a Project Manager with airport experience to deliver EMMA's products at airports, from contract signature to go-live and handover. We expect you to use AI tools for the routine parts of the job, so your time goes on customers, risks and decisions.

EMMA Systems is an airport operations software company. Our products cover the operational database and resource management core, airport collaborative decision making (A-CDM), pre-departure sequencing and turnaround monitoring.

You will work directly with airport project teams, our engineers and consultants, and the founders. EMMA is a startup: the team is small, decisions are fast, and you will see your projects go live at real airports.
The role is based in Doha, Qatar. If you are elsewhere, you would relocate.
q: 5+ years managing software or systems implementation projects for external customers, from kick-off to go-live.
Has managed scope, schedule, budget and risk on several projects at once.
Has run steering committees and handled difficult customer conversations.
Writes clear plans, reports and minutes.
Airport experience (required): has worked for an airport operator, or has delivered systems or projects on site at airports for a supplier or integrator.
Understands airport operations: the turnaround, stand and gate allocation, and how the operator, airlines, handlers and air traffic control work together.
Comfortable in an airport operations control centre and with operational users.
Uses AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT every day in project work, and can show examples.
Has automated recurring project work, such as status reports, minutes or action tracking, with AI tools.
Checks AI output critically, and knows where these tools go wrong.
Understands how web applications, APIs and system integrations work, well enough to challenge a plan or an estimate.
Has worked with engineering teams using Jira or a similar tool.
Writes and speaks clearly in English.
A self-starter who has worked in a startup or a small team, and does not wait to be told what to do.
Based in Doha, or willing to relocate there, and willing to travel regularly.
Experience delivering airport systems such as AODB, resource management or A-CDM.
A-CDM implementation experience, including trials with airlines, ground handlers and air traffic control.
Experience on the airline, ground handling or air navigation side as well.
PMP, PRINCE2 or an Agile certification.
Experience with government or public-sector customers and formal acceptance procedures.
Experience delivering through partners or as a subcontractor.
r: li
Own delivery of your projects end to end: scope, plan, budget, risks and reporting.
li
Be the customer's main point of contact, and run project meetings and steering committees.
li
Plan and coordinate integrations with airport and third-party systems, with our engineers and the customer's IT team.
li
Organise workshops, training, operational trials, user acceptance testing and go-live.
li
Manage scope and change requests, and protect the contract's milestones and payment schedule.
li
Coordinate EMMA's engineers, consultants and partners across locations and time zones.
li
Track actions, risks and issues, and escalate early.
li
Use AI tools to draft plans, minutes, status reports and project documents, and to keep them current.
li
Hand over cleanly to support after go-live, with documentation the customer can use.
li
Feed what you learn at each airport back to product and to the next project.
li
Travel to customer airports for the key phases of each project.
x: Apply here, or send your CV, a short note on a project you delivered and are proud of, and a few lines on how you use AI in your work, to careers@emma.aero with the subject line PJM-01.

d: Do you see yourself as a Sales Executive - Leisure at InterContinental Hotels Group® at Dubai Festival City?

As the world’s first and most global luxury hotel brand, InterContinental Hotels & Resorts has pioneered international travel since the 1940s, we are passionate about sharing our renowned international know-how and cultural wisdom in truly impressive surroundings. We all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental®️ brand and to be part of the brand you will have a thirst for travel, passion for culture and appreciation for diversity. We create inspiring experiences for those seeking a richer perspective on the world. If you’d like to embrace a world of opportunities, we’d like to welcome you to the world’s most international luxury hotel brand.

The IHG Hotels at Dubai Festival City consists of four hotels. These include the luxury and lifestyle brand InterContinental, the lavish long-stay InterContinental Residence Suites, the premium Crowne Plaza, and the essentials Holiday Inn & Suites. In addition to over 1,600 rooms, the cluster boasts a selection of 16 restaurants and bars, an impressive 3,800-square-metre Event Centre across two levels, the 5,000-square-metre Festival Arena by InterContinental, the luxurious Spa InterContinental, and state-of-the-art gym and swimming pool facilities. We are looking for people who are friendly, welcoming, and full of life to join over 1,200 colleagues who are always finding ways to make every guest's experience an enjoyable one. We value the passion and enthusiasm of our colleagues and encourage you to share your passion when you work with us.
q: A minimum of 1–2 years’ experience in the service or hospitality industry, ideally in Sales &Marketing or a related commercial function.
A high level of energy, enthusiasm, and results-driven mindset with an eye for quality and customer focus.
Self-motivated, organised, and collaborative, with a team-oriented approach.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills to nurture lasting professional relationships.
Ambition to grow and eagerness to learn within a global hospitality environment.
Sound judgement and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to make considered decisions under pressure.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and IHG sales tools.
What you can expect from us

We give our people everything they need to succeed, from a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life – including impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate differences and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance, always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the Room to Belong, Room to Grow, and a Room to Make a Difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well – both inside and outside of work – and through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.
So, join us, and you’ll become part of our ever-growing global family.
